# LLMS.TXT - AI Crawler Roadmap

## Organization Information
- Name: Royal Priesthood Assemblies International
- Alternate name: RPAI
- Mission: A church family in Lusaka, Zambia, helping people grow in faith, prayer and service.
- Motto: A place of love where everyone counts.
- Founder and General Overseer: Apostle Dr. Mighty Zunga
- Location: Otwa Events, Long Acres, Ndeke Road, Lusaka, Zambia
- Sunday Divine Service: 09:00 AM CAT
- Midweek Interactive Fellowship: Wednesdays at 05:30 PM CAT, virtual and cell locations
- Website: https://royal-priesthood-assemblies-int-l-1.onrender.com/

## Content Focus
This website contains information about church services, ministries, events, worship recordings, audio messages and giving opportunities. Content is faith-based, with a focus on community outreach, discipleship and worship.
